name: Dr. V. Sivadasan
education: B.A.(History), M.A. (History), Ph.D. (History), Post-doctoral Fellow Educated at PRNSS College, Mattannur, Govt. Brennen College, Thalassery, Kannur University , Centre for Informal Sector and Labour Studies, Jawaharlal Nehru University, Delhi (ICSSR Post Doctoral Fellow), New Delhi
permanent_address: Velluva House, Vilakkode P.O. Muzhakkunnu, Kannur. 670703
books: (i) Peasants, Media, Literature Agrarian Problems in Kerala: Role of the Media and Literature (1934-1971), (ii) Nilavilikalilodungathathe, 2003 (Malayalam) and (iii) Indian Vidhyabhyasam (Malayalam)
social_activities: First rank holder and Gold medalist in Bachelor of Arts in History from Kannur University; has written an article ‘Neoliberal Hegemony in Education: Higher Education Policies in India' (IJSSR Vol.18); frequently writes on the national and international polity in different journals as well as other publications
countries_visited: Was part of the Indian delegation in number of international conferences and seminars in different countries and delivered/invited lectures in many international events; Visited, South Africa and Ecuador, to attend international conferences on youth and students; Philippines and Sri Lanka, to attend Cuban solidarity conference; China, to attend International seminar on development and poverty alleviation; Oman, for a Special talk on 'The life and works of Sree Narayana Guru, and Renaissance’; U.A.E. and Saudi Arabia to attend international conferences and seminars
other_information: Chairman, Kannur University Union, 2002-2003; National President, Students' Federation of India (SFI), 2012 - 2016; Joint Secretary, All India Agricultural Workers' Union (AIAWU); State Committee Member, Communist Party of India (Marxist), Kerala; Convener, Academic Committee, Seminar on Higher Education Challenges and Prospects, Kannur University, Kerala; Acting Chairman and Convener, Academic Committee, Young Scholars Congress, Thiruvananthapuram; Member, (i) Centre for South Indian Studies, (ii) Indian History Congress and (iii) Editorial Board, Marxist Samvadam, Malayalam quarterly Journal, Thiruvananthapuram; Chairman, People's Mission for Social Development; Editor, (i) Researcher, research journal, Thiruvananthapuram, (ii) Indian Researcher, research journal, New Delhi, (iii) Student Struggle, monthly, New Delhi, (iv) Student, Malayalam monthly, Thiruvananthapuram, and (v) Chatra Sangharsh, monthly, New Delhi; Manager, Student, Malayalam monthly, Thiruvananthapuram
